checkpoints.name: suite_has_three_tests
checkpoints.description: Three tests run across eight seeds. Two are directed; one draws random operands.

checkpoints.name: directed_tests_are_stable
checkpoints.description: The two directed tests pass on every seed — deterministic, not flaky. This is the contrast the lab needs.

checkpoints.name: random_stress_is_flaky
checkpoints.description: The random test passes on some seeds and fails on others — the definition of flaky. It is not a bad test: it is a real bug (negative-overflow saturation) surfacing only on inputs some seeds happen to generate.
